text: The Bullgors already rank among the finest of the Chaos Children, yet even amongst their kind, the Khorngors are the most dangerous breed. Their strength clearly surpasses that of the Bullgors, and unsurprisingly, these beasts marked by the God of Battle are more savage, more volatile, and even less capable of restraining their bloodlust. Their crimson armour matches well with the red hide of the daemons of Khorne, and they charge recklessly into battle lines that would give even other Bullgors pause. Without question, among the countless daemonic hosts one might encounter, they are among the most ferocious creatures of all.
Khorngors further blessed by the Blood God, clad in superior armour, tearing through any foe upon the battle line.

This warband is comprised of a Bloodletter Priest, five Skulltakers, and ten Bloodstained Berserkers. They wander between the realms not for wealth, but to experience every form of combat and glimpse the true face of the 'Red God.' Their battles seek neither victory nor conquest, but blood and frenzy - the most rabid followers within the Crimson Path.
A band of unbound followers of Khorne who forsake his traditional ways of war, their bodies riddled with all manner of mutation.

Exalted Eightbound are extreme, savage Chaos Warriors possessed by eight daemons, forming a fused body housing eight daemonic souls. Such beings endure brutal trials while imprisoned within the 'Eightfold Cage,' and those who survive are fully merged with the eight daemons, becoming truly terrifying warriors.
The souls of the Eightbound have completely fused with the eight daemons, becoming a truly 'Exalted' being, surpassing their kin in both power and savagery.

Upon Khorne's eternal battlefield, efficiency itself is a form of devotion. Yet there are always those Chaos Knights whose bloodlust burns so fiercely that no mortal steed can bear the weight of their fury. For these chosen 'fortunate ones,' the artisans of the Blood God have granted a sacred fusion - through blasphemous living forge-craft, the knight's lower body is forcibly stitched and reshaped together with their loyal, equally bloodthirsty Flesh Hound, bone interlocking with bone, nerve fused with nerve, birthing a terrible being that shares a single, unified will to kill. Thus were the Flesh Hound Knights born.

A hunting unit of the Blood God's forces. These knights were permanently fused with Flesh Hounds in a dark ritual, becoming a single butcher housing two souls, existing only to savor the purest ecstasy of tearing their prey apart.

Deep within Khorne's iron fortresses echoes not only savage roars, but also the precise ring of blades cutting the air. These are the 'Blood Sisters' - the personal guard and executioners of the Chosen Bride, Valkia. They do not hail from the savage tribes of the north, but were selected from among countless female warriors who proved themselves to possess a 'precision' beyond mere frenzy. In them, Valkia sees blades that reflect her own glory.

The lethal retinue of the Blood God's Bride. These sisters are champions personally chosen by Valkia, fusing the dance of death with an insatiable hunger for skulls - their blades move so swiftly that only the sound of spraying blood can keep pace.
